name: update_skipping_dust
description: Update skipping: with max-chained-neighbor-updates lowered to 40, a lever powers a 14-wire dust line into a lamp. Every wire that changes power queues updates around it in one chain; once 40 are queued the rest are dropped, so the far end of the line keeps its old power until something updates it. A second lever at the far end is then flipped, which updates the stale wires.
